rows.title: All dogma effects
rows.acceptance: Every dogma effect in res:/staticdata/effects.fsdbinary (2854 effects) evaluates through the generic modifierInfo/expression engine with correct domain/func/operation, and has an attested data-driven test. Attest each as effect:<effectID>; the count must equal the client file.

rows.title: SSO OAuth login
rows.acceptance: Launcher obtains an SSO token (authorization-code + PKCE) and the client exchanges it in authentication.Login; invalid/expired tokens are rejected with the V24 error.

rows.title: Client handshake & version check
rows.acceptance: machoNet handshake accepts the V24 build/protocol version, rejects mismatched builds, and establishes the session (userid, role, languageID).

rows.title: Logout / session teardown
rows.acceptance: authentication.Logout ends the session, saves location and triggers safe removal of the character from space.

rows.title: Multi-login blocker
rows.acceptance: multiLoginBlocker.Login kicks or refuses a second concurrent session on the same account per V24 rules.

rows.title: Account roles & GM flag
rows.acceptance: Account roles (player, GM, admin) persisted and sent in session; privileged calls gated by role.

rows.title: Account bans/suspensions
rows.acceptance: Banned or suspended accounts are refused at login with the correct ban message and expiry.

rows.title: EULA/legal agreements
rows.acceptance: Pending legal agreements must be accepted before character selection; acceptance persisted per account.

rows.title: Language selection
rows.acceptance: authentication.SetLanguageID persists the account language and localized strings are served accordingly.

rows.title: Play-time accounting
rows.acceptance: authentication.AccruedTime / AmUnderage and userSvc.GetSessionPlaytimeMinutes return real values.

rows.title: Subscription / Omega time
rows.acceptance: subscriptionMgr.GetSubscriptionTime and GetCloneGrade reflect account Omega expiry; expiry downgrades all characters to Alpha.

rows.title: Alpha/Omega transition
rows.acceptance: On Omega lapse characters keep skills but alpha-restricted skills become inactive; on renewal they reactivate immediately without relog where V24 does.

rows.title: Multiple Character Training
rows.acceptance: userSvc.ActivateMultiTraining consumes an MCT certificate and opens a training slot for 30 days; GetMultiCharactersTrainingSlots lists slots.

rows.title: Redeem items (gifts)
rows.acceptance: userSvc.GetRedeemTokens lists pending redeemables; ClaimRedeemTokens delivers items to the selected character/station.

rows.title: Character resculpt token
rows.acceptance: userSvc.ActivateCharacterReSculpt grants a full re-sculpt; consumption is persisted.

rows.title: Launcher server status
rows.acceptance: Server exposes status (online/players/version/VIP) consumed by the launcher and ESI /status/.

rows.title: Login queue / population cap
rows.acceptance: populationCap.GetCharacterLoadSlot and MoveCharacterToNewSystem gate entry into overloaded systems.

rows.title: Steam/Epic linked accounts
rows.acceptance: Logins via Steam/Epic federated identities map to the same EVE account and entitlements.

rows.title: Twitch drops / federated entitlements
rows.acceptance: Linked Twitch entitlements are granted as redeemable items.

rows.title: Character transfer between accounts

rows.title: Regional auth variants (Serenity/Kiring)
rows.acceptance: kiringMgr auth/anti-addiction paths are stubbed to report disabled for Tranquility parity.

rows.title: Banned word filter
rows.acceptance: bannedwords.check_words_allowed validates names/chat/search against server regex list.

rows.title: Player reports
rows.acceptance: ingamereport.report_* (bot, language, name, scam) are recorded for GM review.

rows.title: Support petitions
rows.acceptance: petitioner.CreatePetition/GetMyPetitionsEx/CancelPetition and GM claim/close flow with logs.

rows.title: In-client surveys
rows.acceptance: survey.GetActiveSurveyID/PerformSurveyChecks/ClaimSurveyRewards work and rewards are granted once.

rows.title: Character selection list
rows.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.GetCharacterInfo returns all characters on the account with portrait, location, ship, skill training and wallet summary.

rows.title: Select character & enter game
rows.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.SelectCharacterID builds the character session (station/structure or space) and loads inventory and ship.

rows.title: Create character with doll
rows.acceptance: CreateCharacterWithDoll validates name, race, bloodline, ancestry, school and doll; places the character in the starter system with a corvette.

rows.title: Random valid name
rows.acceptance: GetValidRandomName returns an unused name valid for the chosen bloodline.

rows.title: Name validation
rows.acceptance: Name uniqueness, length, character set and banned-word checks are enforced (ValidateNameEx semantics).

rows.title: Starter skills
rows.acceptance: New characters receive the V24 starter skill set and free SP for their race/school.

rows.title: School corporation assignment
rows.acceptance: New characters join their school NPC corp (e.g. State War Academy) and get its home station.

rows.title: Character biomass (delete)
rows.acceptance: PrepareCharacterForDelete starts the timer, CancelCharacterDeletePrepare aborts, DeleteCharacter biomasses after the delay; character becomes Doomheim.

rows.title: Character slot limit
rows.acceptance: An account holds at most 3 characters; creation beyond the limit is rejected (GetNumCharacters).

rows.title: Paperdoll storage
rows.acceptance: paperDollServer persists sculpt/doll data and returns it via GetMyPaperDollData/GetPaperDollData/Batch.

rows.title: Recustomization
rows.acceptance: UpdateExistingCharacterLimited allows clothing/hair changes; UpdateExistingCharacterFull requires a resculpt token.

rows.title: Portrait render/upload
rows.acceptance: photoUploadSvc accepts rendered portraits and image server serves them at all standard sizes.

rows.title: Bloodline update
rows.acceptance: charUnboundMgr.UpdateCharacterBloodline is honoured during resculpt where allowed.

rows.title: Character public info
rows.acceptance: charMgr.GetPublicInfo returns corp, alliance, race, bloodline, security status, birthday and portrait for show-info.

rows.title: Character biography
rows.acceptance: Editing the bio (SetCharacterDescription) persists and is shown on show-info.

rows.title: Employment history
rows.acceptance: corporationSvc.GetEmploymentRecord returns all past corps with join dates.

rows.title: Owner notes
rows.acceptance: charMgr.AddOwnerNote/EditOwnerNote/GetOwnerNote persist private notes on any owner.

rows.title: Character sheet data
rows.acceptance: Character sheet shows skills, attributes, implants, jump clones, standings, security status, kill rights, medals, decorations.

rows.title: Home station
rows.acceptance: home_station.get_home_station/set_home_station with remote change cooldown (get_next_remote_change_time) and candidate list.

rows.title: Self-destruct to home station
rows.acceptance: home_station.self_destruct_clone moves a podded character back to their home station clone.

rows.title: Character cosmetic titles
rows.acceptance: Earned cosmetic titles are owned, equipable and displayed next to the name.

rows.title: Medal decorations
rows.acceptance: Received medals appear on the character sheet with public/private visibility via SetMedalStatus.

rows.title: Online status
rows.acceptance: onlineStatus.GetOnlineStatus returns online state for contacts who allow it.

rows.title: Safe logoff
rows.acceptance: ship.SafeLogoff/AbortSafeLogoff: after 30s with no aggression the ship is removed from space instantly.

rows.title: Logoff emergency warp
rows.acceptance: Disconnecting in space without timers triggers emergency warp then removal after the timer.

rows.title: Cohort membership
rows.acceptance: charMgr.GetCohortsForCharacter/charUnboundMgr.GetCohortsForUser return cohort tags used for feature gating.

rows.title: Character energy state
rows.acceptance: characterEnergyMgr.GetMyEnergyState returns current energy values used by V24 features.

rows.title: Character lock types
rows.acceptance: GetCharacterLockType reports locks (transfer, delete pending, GM) and blocks selection when locked.

rows.title: Get skill queue
rows.acceptance: skillMgr2 handler GetSkillQueue returns ordered entries with start/end times.

rows.title: Save skill queue
rows.acceptance: SaveSkillQueue replaces the whole queue; validates prerequisites, alpha caps and max length (50 entries / 10-year window).

rows.title: Real-time training engine
rows.acceptance: SP accrue at (primary + secondary/2) per minute; levels complete at the right instant and OnSkillTrained fires even offline-then-login.

rows.title: Pause/resume training
rows.acceptance: Emptying the queue or AbortTraining pauses; restarting resumes from current SP.

rows.title: SP per level
rows.acceptance: Level thresholds follow 250*rank*sqrt(32)^(L-1); character SP and per-skill SP are consistent.

rows.title: Skill history
rows.acceptance: GetSkillHistory returns trained/injected/removed events with timestamps.

rows.title: Inject skillbook
rows.acceptance: InjectSkillIntoBrain consumes the book, adds the skill at level 0, and rejects already-known skills.

rows.title: Prerequisite enforcement
rows.acceptance: Queue and module/ship use honour required skills and levels (dogmaIM.GetRequiredSkillLevels).

rows.title: Alpha skill caps
rows.acceptance: Alpha characters cannot train above the alpha cap per skill; SP above cap is inactive.

rows.title: Alpha training speed
rows.acceptance: Alpha clones train at half speed versus Omega.

rows.title: Unallocated SP
rows.acceptance: ApplyFreeSkillPoints(typeID, points) applies unallocated SP to the given skill only.

rows.title: Skill extractor
rows.acceptance: Extractor removes 500,000 SP from chosen skills producing a Large Skill Injector; requires Omega and >5.5M SP.

rows.title: Large skill injector
rows.acceptance: Injection grants SP by total SP bracket (500k/400k/300k/150k).

rows.title: Small skill injector
rows.acceptance: Small injector grants 1/5 of the large amount.

rows.title: Daily alpha injector
rows.acceptance: alphaInjectorMgr.GetNextAvailableInjection enforces one per 24h for Alphas.

rows.title: Non-diminishing injectors
rows.acceptance: nonDiminishingInjectionMgr returns available non-diminishing injections and grants the fixed SP.

rows.title: Expert Systems
rows.acceptance: expertSystemMgr.ConsumeExpertSystem grants temporary skills for the duration; GetMyExpertSystems/RemoveMyExpertSystem work; expiry removes the skills.

rows.title: Skill plans
rows.acceptance: Personal/corp/certified skill plans are stored, shared and tracked.

rows.title: Certificates
rows.acceptance: certificateMgr reports certificate levels derived from trained skills.

rows.title: Skill bonuses in dogma
rows.acceptance: Trained skill levels modify ship/module attributes via dogma.

rows.title: Cerebral accelerators
rows.acceptance: Accelerator boosters raise all attributes for their duration, affecting training speed.

rows.title: Skill offline catch-up
rows.acceptance: On login the server credits training that completed while offline in the correct order.

rows.title: Obsolete skill refund
rows.acceptance: Removed/obsolete skills refund SP as unallocated SP.

rows.title: Character attributes
rows.acceptance: Five attributes (Int/Mem/Per/Will/Cha) derived from base + remap + implants + accelerators.

rows.title: Neural remap
rows.acceptance: RespecCharacter redistributes points within limits; one remap per year plus bonus remaps.

rows.title: Bonus remaps
rows.acceptance: Bonus remaps are consumable at any time and counted separately.

rows.title: Plug in implant
rows.acceptance: Implant plugging requires skill, occupies its slot, refuses occupied slots and applies dogma effects.

rows.title: Remove implant
rows.acceptance: Removing an implant destroys it (no unplugging back to inventory).

rows.title: Implant set bonuses
rows.acceptance: Pirate sets (Crystal, Snake, Halo, Ascendancy, etc.) apply set multipliers.

rows.title: Implants lost on pod death
rows.acceptance: Pod death destroys active-clone implants.

rows.title: Consume booster
rows.acceptance: Boosters occupy booster slots, apply bonuses for their duration and expire.

rows.title: Booster side effects
rows.acceptance: Each side effect rolls by chance; Nanite Control and Neurotoxin Recovery reduce chance/penalty.

rows.title: Booster contraband
rows.acceptance: Contraband boosters can be confiscated by customs in high-sec.

rows.title: Pod respawn
rows.acceptance: Podded characters wake in their medical clone at the home station with a new capsule.

rows.title: Install jump clone
rows.acceptance: jumpCloneSvc.InstallCloneInStation/Structure requires Infomorph Psychology slots and standing/structure service.

rows.title: Clone jump
rows.acceptance: CloneJump swaps to a clone at another location; requires being docked, 24h cooldown reduced by Infomorph Synchronizing.

rows.title: Destroy jump clone
rows.acceptance: DestroyInstalledClone removes the clone and its implants.

rows.title: Name jump clone
rows.acceptance: SetJumpCloneName persists a label.

rows.title: Ship clone vat bay
rows.acceptance: OfferShipCloneInstallation/AcceptShipCloneInstallation installs clones in Titan/Rorqual/etc. clone bays.

rows.title: Clone state query
rows.acceptance: GetCloneState/GetStationCloneState/GetShipCloneState return accurate clones, implants and timers.

rows.title: Structure clone bay
rows.acceptance: Clone bay service on Upwell structures is required and access-list gated.

rows.title: Clone loss with structure
rows.acceptance: Clones in a destroyed structure are moved home (implants lost) per V24 rules.

rows.title: Board ship in hangar
rows.acceptance: ship.Board makes the ship active, updates session shipid and fires ProcessActiveShipChanged.

rows.title: Board ship in space
rows.acceptance: Boarding an unpiloted owned ship within range in space transfers the capsule.

rows.title: Eject from ship
rows.acceptance: ship.Eject leaves the ship abandoned in space and the pilot in a capsule.

rows.title: Assemble ship
rows.acceptance: ship.AssembleShip turns a packaged hull into a singleton ship.

rows.title: Repackage items
rows.acceptance: repackagingSvc.RepackageItems repackages undamaged, empty ships/modules; refuses fitted/damaged items.

rows.title: Rename ship
rows.acceptance: SetShipName persists and shows on overview/show-info.

rows.title: Free corvette
rows.acceptance: dogmaIM.CreateNewbieShip gives a racial corvette when docked in a capsule, at most once per cooldown.

rows.title: Board from ship hangar remotely
rows.acceptance: ship.BoardStoredShip boards a ship from a structure/ship maintenance bay.

rows.title: Ship maintenance bay
rows.acceptance: Carriers/Orca/Rorqual/Titans store assembled ships; fleet members can access per settings.

rows.title: Fleet hangar
rows.acceptance: Fleet hangar access rules for fleet/corp members.

rows.title: Specialized holds
rows.acceptance: Ore, ice, gas, mineral, PI, ammo, fuel, infrastructure, mobile depot holds accept only matching item groups.

rows.title: Cargo capacity
rows.acceptance: Cargo moves refuse overflow by volume; packaged volumes respected.

rows.title: Repair shop
rows.acceptance: Station/structure repair service quotes and repairs hull/armor/module damage for ISK.

rows.title: T3D modes
rows.acceptance: shipStanceMgr.SetShipStance switches Defense/Sharpshooter/Propulsion modes with a cooldown; mode bonuses applied.

rows.title: Ship tree data
rows.acceptance: Ship tree UI shows all hulls by faction/class with skill requirements and mastery.

rows.title: Masteries
rows.acceptance: Mastery level per hull computed from trained certificates.

rows.title: Kill marks
rows.acceptance: shipKillCounter.GetItemKillCountPlayer returns kills recorded for the hull.

rows.title: Insure from hangar
rows.acceptance: Insurance is purchasable from the ship context menu (see insurance rows).

rows.title: Ship configuration
rows.acceptance: ship.GetShipConfiguration/ConfigureShip control maintenance bay/fleet hangar access flags.

rows.title: Self-destruct
rows.acceptance: ship.SelfDestruct destroys the ship after 2 minutes; AbortSelfDestruct cancels; produces a killmail.

rows.title: Jettison cargo
rows.acceptance: ship.Jettison creates a jettison container in space (one per 3 minutes per pilot) with ownership flags.

rows.title: Launch ship from wreck/container
rows.acceptance: eject.LaunchShipOrContainerFromWreckOrContainer launches an assembled ship from a container into space.

rows.title: Fit module
rows.acceptance: Fitting a module checks slot type, slot count, CPU, powergrid, calibration, group/fit limits, and skills.

rows.title: Unfit module
rows.acceptance: Unfitting returns the module to cargo/hangar; only allowed docked (except fitting service in space).

rows.title: Rigs
rows.acceptance: Rigs consume calibration, size must match hull, unfitting destroys the rig; drawback penalties apply.

rows.title: T3 subsystems
rows.acceptance: Strategic cruisers require exactly one subsystem per type; slot layout updates.

rows.title: Max group fitted
rows.acceptance: Modules with maxGroupFitted/maxGroupOnline (e.g. one DCU, one cloak) are enforced.

rows.title: Ship-specific limits
rows.acceptance: Modules restricted to certain hulls (canFitShipGroup/Type) enforced.

rows.title: Online/offline modules
rows.acceptance: SetModuleOnline/TakeModuleOffline; onlining needs 75% cap in space and CPU/PG headroom.

rows.title: Saved fittings
rows.acceptance: charFittingMgr/corpFittingMgr/allianceFittingMgr save, list, delete and share fittings with limits.

rows.title: Fit from saved fitting
rows.acceptance: ship.FitShips applies a saved fitting from available hangar items and reports missing items.

rows.title: Community fittings
rows.acceptance: corpFittingMgr.GetCommunityFittings returns CCP-curated fits.

rows.title: Fitting in space
rows.acceptance: Refit allowed near carriers/Orcas/mobile depots/structures with fitting services.

rows.title: Load ammo/charges
rows.acceptance: dogmaIM.LoadAmmo loads compatible charges respecting capacity, with reload time.

rows.title: Unload ammo
rows.acceptance: UnloadAmmo returns charges to cargo/hangar.

rows.title: Weapon grouping
rows.acceptance: LinkWeapons/LinkAllWeapons/UnlinkModule/PeelAndLink/MergeModuleGroups group identical turrets/launchers.

rows.title: Overheating
rows.acceptance: Overloaded modules gain bonuses, deal heat damage to themselves and adjacent racks; burnt modules go offline.

rows.title: Module repair
rows.acceptance: Damaged modules are repaired with nanite paste in space or at repair service.

rows.title: Fitting simulation
rows.acceptance: Client-side simulation works with server-provided type/dogma data (no server state).

rows.title: Stacking penalties
rows.acceptance: Same-attribute multipliers stack-penalized with exp(-(n/2.67)^2).

rows.title: Dogma modifier engine
rows.acceptance: All V24 modifierInfo operations (pre/post assign/add/mul/div/percent) for item, location, owner-required-skill and group modifiers.

rows.title: Attribute sync to client
rows.acceptance: Changed attributes are pushed via OnModuleAttributeChanges/OnGodmaShipEffect.

rows.title: Godma location priming
rows.acceptance: Docking/undocking primes godma for the location (ProcessGodmaPrimeLocation).

rows.title: Module activation cycle
rows.acceptance: Activate/Deactivate with cycle time, capacitor cost, repeat count and deactivation at cycle end.

rows.title: Reactivation delay
rows.acceptance: Modules with moduleReactivationDelay cannot reactivate early.

rows.title: Capacitor recharge
rows.acceptance: Cap regenerates per the EVE curve (peak at 25%).

rows.title: Capacitor usage accounting
rows.acceptance: Module cap use, neutralizing and boosting adjust capacitor correctly.

rows.title: Passive shield recharge
rows.acceptance: Shield regenerates per the recharge curve (peak at ~25%).

rows.title: Target locking
rows.acceptance: Lock time from scan resolution vs signature radius; max targets/range limits; OnTarget notifications.

rows.title: Lock breaking
rows.acceptance: Locks drop on cloaking, warp, out of range, ECM jam.

rows.title: Sensor strength
rows.acceptance: Racial sensor strength used for ECM and probe scanning.

rows.title: Resistances
rows.acceptance: Shield/armor/hull resistances reduce damage by type.

rows.title: Signature radius effects
rows.acceptance: Signature radius affects lock time, missile application, turret tracking and probe strength.

rows.title: Velocity and agility
rows.acceptance: Max velocity, inertia and mass determine acceleration and align time.

rows.title: System-wide effects
rows.acceptance: Wormhole effects, Pochven/insurgency and metaliminal storms apply system dbuffs (OnSystemWideEffectAdd).

rows.title: Dynamic buffs (dbuff)
rows.acceptance: Command bursts, storms, and other dbuff collections apply with max/min aggregation and expire.

rows.title: Weapons timer
rows.acceptance: Activating offensive modules sets a 60s weapons timer blocking docking/jumping.

rows.title: Ship role/bonus effects
rows.acceptance: Hull bonuses per skill level and role bonuses apply from SDE effects.

rows.title: Hybrid turrets (blasters/railguns)
rows.acceptance: Blasters and railguns consume hybrid charges and deal kin/therm damage per turret formula; damage notifications emitted.

rows.title: Projectile turrets (autocannons/artillery)
rows.acceptance: Projectile ammo damage types/ranges applied; no cap use.

rows.title: Energy turrets (pulse/beam)
rows.acceptance: Lasers use cap and frequency crystals; T2 crystals degrade; faction crystals damage per cycle.

rows.title: Turret hit chance formula
rows.acceptance: Hit chance = 0.5^((tracking term)^2 + (range term)^2) with optimal/falloff; wrecking hits at 1%.

rows.title: Entropic disintegrators
rows.acceptance: Triglavian disintegrators spool damage multiplier per cycle on the same target, reset on target change.

rows.title: Vorton projectors
rows.acceptance: EDENCOM arc weapons chain damage to nearby targets with arc range/count.

rows.title: Missile launchers
rows.acceptance: Rockets/LML/HML/HAM/cruise/torpedo/XL launchers fire missile entities with flight time and velocity.

rows.title: Missile damage application
rows.acceptance: Damage scaled by explosion radius/velocity vs target sig/speed with DRF formula.

rows.title: Defender missiles
rows.acceptance: Defender missiles target incoming missiles.

rows.title: FoF missiles
rows.acceptance: Auto-targeting missiles pick aggressors while jammed.

rows.title: Smartbombs
rows.acceptance: Area damage centered on ship; CONCORD response in high-sec; hits all including fleet in range.

rows.title: Bombs (stealth bomber)
rows.acceptance: Bomb launchers fire bombs that detonate at range for AoE damage; lockbreaker/void bombs special effects; not in high-sec.

rows.title: Titan doomsdays
rows.acceptance: superWeaponMgr.ActivateSinglePointTargetedModule/ActivateSlashModule: single-target and lance doomsdays with warmup and delays.

rows.title: Capital weapons & HAW
rows.acceptance: XL turrets/launchers and High Angle Weapons apply per capital formulas.

rows.title: Breacher pods
rows.acceptance: Breacher pod launchers apply % and flat HP DoT that does not stack per target.

rows.title: Damage modifiers
rows.acceptance: Gyrostabilizer, heat sink, magnetic field stabilizer, BCU, entropic radiation sink, drone damage amp, vorton tuning apply ROF/damage with stacking.

rows.title: Tracking computers/enhancers & missile guidance
rows.acceptance: TC/TE/MGC/MGE modify tracking/optimal/falloff/missile stats; scripts change bonus.

rows.title: Shield boosters
rows.acceptance: Local shield booster restores shield per cycle; X-Large/capital variants.

rows.title: Ancillary shield boosters
rows.acceptance: ASB runs on cap boosters with bonus, falls back to capacitor when empty; reload 60s.

rows.title: Shield extenders/hardeners/amplifiers
rows.acceptance: Passive extenders add HP; active hardeners and amplifiers raise resists.

rows.title: Armor repairers
rows.acceptance: Local reps restore armor at cycle end.

rows.title: Ancillary armor repairers
rows.acceptance: AAR triples rep with nanite paste loaded.

rows.title: Plates/hardeners/EANM
rows.acceptance: Plates add HP+mass; active/passive hardeners raise resists.

rows.title: Reactive armor hardener
rows.acceptance: RAH shifts resists toward incoming damage types each cycle.

rows.title: Damage control
rows.acceptance: DCU adds hull/armor/shield resists, one per ship.

rows.title: Hull repairers & bulkheads
rows.acceptance: Hull reps and reinforced bulkheads function.

rows.title: Assault damage control
rows.acceptance: ADC grants a burst of resists with reactivation delay on assault ships.

rows.title: Remote shield boosters
rows.acceptance: Remote shield transfer heals target shield; logi aggression flags applied.

rows.title: Remote armor repairers
rows.acceptance: Remote armor reps heal target armor; mutadaptive spool-up for Triglavian.

rows.title: Remote hull repairers
rows.acceptance: Remote hull reps heal target structure.

rows.title: Remote capacitor transmitter
rows.acceptance: Transfers capacitor to target.

rows.title: Capacitor boosters
rows.acceptance: Inject capacitor from charges with reload.

rows.title: Cap batteries/rechargers/power relays/flux coils
rows.acceptance: Passive capacitor modules modify capacity/recharge; batteries resist neuts.

rows.title: ECM jammers
rows.acceptance: Jam chance = jammer strength/sensor strength; jammed ship loses locks for 20s; burst jammers AoE.

rows.title: Remote sensor dampeners
rows.acceptance: Reduce target lock range or scan resolution per script.

rows.title: Weapon disruptors
rows.acceptance: Tracking disruptors and guidance disruptors reduce turret/missile stats per script.

rows.title: Target painters
rows.acceptance: Increase target signature radius.

rows.title: Stasis webifiers
rows.acceptance: Reduce target velocity with range/falloff; grapplers.

rows.title: Warp disruptors/scramblers
rows.acceptance: Apply warp scramble strength vs warp core strength; scramblers stop MWD/MJD.

rows.title: Energy neutralizers
rows.acceptance: Drain target capacitor (and nosferatu transfer to self).

rows.title: ECCM/sensor boosters/signal amps
rows.acceptance: Increase sensor strength, lock range, scan res, max targets.

rows.title: Burst jammer
rows.acceptance: AoE ECM affecting all ships in range.

rows.title: Burst projectors
rows.acceptance: Area EWAR projectors (ECM, weapon disruption, dampening, warp disruption, target illumination) on Black Ops/Recons.

rows.title: Interdiction sphere launcher
rows.acceptance: Dictor bubbles spawn a warp disruption field in null/WH; prevents warp and drags warpers.

rows.title: Warp disruption field generator
rows.acceptance: HIC infinite point/bubble mode with penalties.

rows.title: Mobile warp disruptors
rows.acceptance: Anchorable bubbles in nullsec with deploy timers.

rows.title: Afterburners
rows.acceptance: Increase max velocity; mass additive.

rows.title: Microwarpdrives
rows.acceptance: Increase speed and signature radius; cap penalty; disabled by scrams.

rows.title: Micro jump drive
rows.acceptance: MJD jumps 100 km forward after 12s spool; field variant jumps nearby ships.

rows.title: Nanofibers/overdrives/inertial stabs
rows.acceptance: Passive speed/agility modules.

rows.title: Warp core stabilizers
rows.acceptance: Add warp core strength with lock range/scan penalties.

rows.title: Interdiction nullification
rows.acceptance: Nullified ships ignore bubbles.

rows.title: Cloaking devices
rows.acceptance: Cloaks fail within 2 km of objects, block locking, reduce speed; covert cloaks allow warping cloaked.

rows.title: Decloak rules
rows.acceptance: Proximity to objects decloaks; activating modules/targeting impossible while cloaked; targeting delay after decloak.

rows.title: Covert ops cloak
rows.acceptance: Covert hulls warp cloaked; no targeting delay penalty variants.

rows.title: Cynosural field generator
rows.acceptance: Lights a cyno beacon for 5 min (non-covert), consumes Liquid Ozone, fixes ship in place.

rows.title: Covert cyno
rows.acceptance: Covert cynos allow Black Ops and covert jump portals.

rows.title: Industrial cyno
rows.acceptance: Industrial cyno allows jump freighters and rorquals only.

rows.title: Cyno jammer
rows.acceptance: Sovereignty Pharolux jammer blocks cynos in system (beyonce.GetCynoJammerState).

rows.title: Jump portal generator
rows.acceptance: Titans/Black Ops bridge fleet members to a cyno with fuel cost and range.

rows.title: Siege module
rows.acceptance: Dreadnought siege: bonuses, immobility, remote assistance immunity, cycle 5 min.

rows.title: Triage module
rows.acceptance: FAX triage: rep bonuses, immobile, cannot receive remote reps.

rows.title: Bastion module
rows.acceptance: Marauder bastion: resists, range, immune to EWAR, immobile.

rows.title: Industrial core
rows.acceptance: Orca/Rorqual core enables boosts/compression, makes ship immobile.

rows.title: Command bursts
rows.acceptance: Burst charges apply fleet dbuffs (shield, armor, skirmish, info, mining) to fleet in range with duration.

rows.title: Salvagers

rows.title: Tractor beams

rows.title: Data/relic analyzers

rows.title: Cargo scanner
rows.acceptance: Show target cargo contents.

rows.title: Ship scanner
rows.acceptance: Show target fitting and capacitor.

rows.title: Survey scanner
rows.acceptance: miningScanMgr.perform_scan returns asteroid quantities in range.

rows.title: Entosis link

rows.title: Clone vat bay
rows.acceptance: Clone vat bay module allows jump clone installation in ships.

rows.title: Mutated module persistence

rows.title: T3C/T3D configuration
rows.acceptance: Subsystem swaps and T3D modes recalculate bonuses.

rows.title: Jump drive economizer & capital rigs
rows.acceptance: Fuel and jump range modifiers apply.

rows.title: Module scripts
rows.acceptance: Scripted modules swap scripts like ammo.

rows.title: Launch drones

rows.acceptance: CmdReturnHome makes drones orbit the ship.

rows.title: Engage target
rows.acceptance: CmdEngage attacks the target with drone weapons; aggression flags applied.

rows.title: Assist/guard
rows.acceptance: CmdAssist assigns drones to a fleet member; CmdGuard protects a target.

rows.title: Drone aggression settings
rows.acceptance: Aggressive/passive and focus fire settings control auto-engagement.

rows.title: Abandon/scoop drones
rows.acceptance: CmdAbandonDrone abandons; scooping to bay reclaims, anyone can scoop abandoned drones.

rows.title: Reconnect to lost drones
rows.acceptance: CmdReconnectToDrones reacquires drones left in space within range.

rows.title: Drone bandwidth
rows.acceptance: Bandwidth limits active drones by size.

rows.title: Drone control range
rows.acceptance: Drones beyond control range return/idle; skills extend range.

rows.title: Mining/ice/gas drones
rows.acceptance: CmdMineRepeatedly: drones mine and deliver ore to ore hold/cargo.

rows.title: Salvage drones
rows.acceptance: CmdSalvage drones salvage wrecks.

rows.title: Logistic drones
rows.acceptance: Remote repair drones heal targets.

rows.title: EWAR drones
rows.acceptance: ECM/web/neut/TP/damp drones apply EWAR.

rows.title: Sentry drones
rows.acceptance: Sentries are immobile and engage at long range.

rows.title: Drone skill/damage modifiers

rows.title: Remote job range

rows.title: Factory cycles

rows.title: PI notifications

rows.title: Remote trading range

rows.title: Sales tax

rows.title: Market groups

rows.title: NPC seeded orders
rows.acceptance: NPC sell orders for skillbooks, blueprints and faction items exist at NPC stations and never deplete incorrectly.

rows.title: Public/private/corp contracts

rows.title: ESI: SSO token issuance & verification

rows.title: ESI: error limits and caching

rows.title: ESI: meta endpoints
rows.acceptance: ESI exposes /swagger.json, /status.json and /verify/ endpoints for clients and token introspection.

rows.title: Launch and log in
rows.acceptance: Start the client pointed at EvoMu, authenticate through emulated SSO/launcher tokens, pass the machoNet handshake, and reach character selection with the account's characters listed.

rows.title: Create a character
rows.acceptance: Create a new character for each of the 4 races (bloodline, ancestry, school, paperdoll, portrait). The character appears in its school station with its starter ship, skills and ISK.

rows.title: Station services
rows.acceptance: Docked: open the hangars, inventory, fitting, market, industry, agency, character sheet, skills, wallet, journal, corporation, people & places, mail, notifications, calendar and NES store windows. All of them populate with no errors.

rows.title: Fit a ship
rows.acceptance: Buy modules on the market, fit them (CPU/PG/slot validation), online them, load ammo, save and load a fitting, and assemble/repackage a ship. Fitting attributes match dogma.

rows.title: Undock and navigate
rows.acceptance: Undock, use the overview, approach/orbit/keep at range, align, warp to a celestial and to a bookmark, set a route, autopilot through 3 stargates, and dock at the destination. Destiny updates are smooth and the camera shows celestials.

rows.title: Chat
rows.acceptance: Local, corp, fleet and private channels: messages appear for a second connected client, and member lists update on jump/dock.

rows.title: Two players
rows.acceptance: Two clients in the same system see each other on the overview and in space, see each other's actions (warp, modules), and can trade directly.

rows.title: Skill training
rows.acceptance: Queue skills, wait while time advances, and see the queue progress and OnSkillTrained arrive. Use skill injectors and extractors, buy and apply a skill plan, and use attribute remap, implants and boosters.

rows.title: Market
rows.acceptance: Place, modify and cancel buy and sell orders, fill them against another player and against NPC-seeded orders, and check the broker fees/taxes, wallet journal, transactions and market history.

rows.title: Contracts
rows.acceptance: Item exchange, auction with bids, and courier contracts (with collateral, delivery and expiry) between two clients.

rows.title: Mining
rows.acceptance: Warp to an asteroid belt, survey scan, mine ore, ice and gas with lasers/harvesters and mining drones into the ore hold, use a mining crystal, deplete an asteroid, check the mining ledger, compress the ore, then dock and reprocess it with skill-based yields.

rows.title: PvE combat
rows.acceptance: Fight belt rats and an anomaly site: lock targets, cycle weapons with capacitor and heat, take and deal damage per dogma, kill the NPCs, loot and salvage the wrecks, and receive the bounty.

rows.title: Missions
rows.acceptance: Take security, distribution, mining and storyline missions from agents in the Agency; complete them in mission pockets with acceleration gates; collect rewards, LP and standings; use the LP store.

rows.title: Exploration
rows.acceptance: Launch probes and scan down a data site, a relic site and a combat signature. Hack containers with the hacking minigame and loot them. Use D-scan.

rows.title: Wormholes and filaments
rows.acceptance: Scan down and jump a wormhole (mass and lifetime limits), then run an abyssal filament (timer, rooms, loot) and a Pochven/Triglavian filament.

rows.title: Ship loss
rows.acceptance: Insure a ship, then lose it to NPCs and to another player. Check the wreck/loot drop, pod ejection, killmail, insurance payout, medical clone respawn and security-status/crimewatch effects (suspect/criminal/CONCORD in high-sec).

rows.title: Clones
rows.acceptance: Install a jump clone, clone-jump with implants, check the cooldown, and set the home station.

rows.title: Industry
rows.acceptance: Run manufacturing, ME/TE research, copying, invention and a reaction in station and in a structure. Check job costs, timers and delivery.

rows.title: Planetary industry
rows.acceptance: Build a colony with extractors, factories, links and routes. Wait while time advances, see the product appear, and export it through a customs office/skyhook with tax.

rows.title: Corporation
rows.acceptance: Create a corporation, invite and accept a second character, set roles/titles, rent an office, use corp hangars and wallet divisions, set tax, use corp projects/opportunities, and create an alliance.

rows.title: Fleet
rows.acceptance: Form a fleet, set wings/squads and roles, broadcast, fleet warp, use command bursts, advertise in the fleet finder and set the MOTD.

rows.title: Upwell structures
rows.acceptance: Anchor, online and fuel a citadel; fit service modules; set access profiles; dock and use services; reinforce it through the timers; check asset safety.

rows.title: Sovereignty and faction warfare
rows.acceptance: Equinox sov: hub, upgrades, power/workforce, skyhook. Enlist in faction warfare, capture a complex, see the system contest update, and receive LP.

rows.title: Agency, daily goals and events
rows.acceptance: Daily goals, opportunities/AIR career program, seasonal events and corp goals progress and pay out through the Quasar/public-gateway services.

rows.title: Cosmetics and store
rows.acceptance: Apply SKINs, SKINR/paragon designs, emblems and corp logos. Use the PLEX vault and NES store purchase flows, and multiple-character training.

rows.title: Mail and notifications
rows.acceptance: Send/receive mail, mailing lists, labels, the notification feed and calendar events between two clients.

rows.title: ESI
rows.acceptance: An external HTTP client obtains an SSO token for a character and calls ESI endpoints in every tag group. The results match the in-client state, including scope enforcement and caching headers.

rows.title: Persistence and downtime
rows.acceptance: Run a scheduled downtime: the server restarts, every piece of state (items, wallets, skills, orders, structures, PI, timers) survives, belts respawn, and daily resets happen.

rows.title: GM tools
rows.acceptance: A GM account uses the slash commands (spawn, create item, give skills, teleport, heal, set attribute, kick/ban). The commands are role-gated: a normal account is refused.
